verdict.rationale: Klaviyo ships built-in AI assistants that take delegated work. Composer, given a goal, builds the audience, drafts content, maps the send strategy, and can make supported changes for your review (klaviyo-docs-25, klaviyo-docs-37). The pricing page lists scheduling recurring tasks, creating campaigns and flows, and getting answers from your data (klaviyo-docs-50). Customer Agent handles support tasks such as order-status updates automatically (klaviyo-docs-26). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation on Composer's scope, limits and permissions beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works in practice.
